title: Celo Euro activates on Celo
description: The euro-tracking Celo stablecoin activated on Celo under the cEUR name.
notes: The day-level launch boundary follows the official Celo governance announcement.

title: Celo Euro becomes Mento Euro
description: Mento renamed cEUR to EURm as part of a portfolio-wide branding change without changing the contract, peg, or holder balances.
notes: The same canonical stablecoin identity continues after the display-name and ticker change.

title: Web 3 Dollar is introduced on Reserve Protocol
description: The USD3 deployer published the initial design and deployment context for the yield-bearing Reserve Protocol RToken.
notes: The official RFC date is used as the supported public launch boundary; the exact contract-creation transaction remains an open item.

title: USD3 publishes its first collateral basket change proposal
description: USD3 governance published an early proposal to change the collateral basket after launch.
notes: The proposal date is recorded; complete execution timing and subsequent basket history remain open items.

title: USD3 publishes Reserve Protocol 3.4.0 upgrade proposal
description: USD3 governance published a proposal to upgrade core contracts and governance components from version 3.0.1 to 3.4.0.
notes: The proposal establishes contract and version context; complete execution transactions remain an open item.

title: USD3 publishes Reserve Protocol 4.2.0 upgrade proposal
description: USD3 governance published a proposal to move core contracts and collateral assets from version 3.4.0 to 4.2.0.
notes: The proposal is not treated as proof that every upgrade step was executed.
